audit.whatIsWrong: Rows 0, 5 and 6 disagree with the already-applied mirror, and row 6 contradicts this page's own whys[6].
audit.why: Mirror (jayce__vayne) set row 0 to Skill and rows 5 and 6 to Vayne. whys[6] here already reads 'Two-plus items favour Vayne' while win[6] said Jayce — the two layers were answering the question differently. Level 1 is even because he has one stance available and 600-range Q against your 550 attack range, before Acceleration Gate exists to extend it.
audit.corrected: Chart: Skill, Jayce, Jayce, Skill, Jayce, Vayne, Vayne, as matched pairs with ratings.

audit.whatIsWrong: The first-item spike said Jayce nearly executes you there; with the corrected chart that stage is the turn.
audit.why: Blade of the Ruined King plus Silver Bolts is percent-max-HP true damage that scales with the fight continuing, while Shock Blast is burst that falls off — and by rank 6 it is a 6s cooldown he is using to farm, not to kill.
audit.corrected: spikes[2] rewritten as the turning point; whys[5] flipped to Vayne.

audit.whatIsWrong: No cooldowns, no stance-swap tell, and Thundering Blow's range was never given.
audit.why: Shock Blast is 16s at rank 1 and 6s at rank 6, so the punish window shrinks as the lane goes on — that alone changes when you can walk up. The stance swap (Mercury Cannon / Mercury Hammer) is a 6s cooldown and the first attack after it is an auto-attack reset that shreds armour and MR, so the weapon wind-up is the cue to step back, not the swap animation. Thundering Blow only reaches 240, so his knockback requires him to be in melee.
audit.corrected: All three written into the do's and don'ts.

edits.before: Level 1 favours Jayce: his cannon Q out-ranges you before you can even trade.
edits.after: Level 1 is even: he only has one stance and you nearly match his range.

edits.before: First item favours Jayce: he can nearly execute you from range while you are still squishy.
edits.after: First item favours Vayne: Botrk's percent-health on-hit already beats his falling poke.

edits.before: Jayce's first item lets him nearly execute you from range; you are still short-ranged and squishy until items catch up.
edits.after: Your first item is the turn: Blade of the Ruined King and Silver Bolts' true damage beat a Shock Blast on a 6s cooldown.

edits.before: Two items on: your side-lane pattern is at full power. Jayce carry threat 8/10 — close before the map decides instead of you.
edits.after: Two items on: Final Hour's invisible Tumbles dodge his hammer combo and percent-health true damage out-scales his fading poke.

edits.before: His main poke. Dodge it. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: Shock Blast is 16s at rank 1 and 6s at rank 6 — count it.

edits.before: Jayce wastes Shock Blast — commit the full pattern immediately.
edits.after: His stance swap is a 6s auto reset — the wind-up is the tell.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Thundering Blow only reaches 240 — his knockback needs melee.

notes: win[6] said Jayce while whys[6] on the same page said 'Two-plus items favour Vayne' — the exact two-layer disagreement the regression check exists to catch. Realigned rows 0, 5 and 6 to the already-applied mirror as matched pairs. The stance-swap auto reset (6s, and the first hit shreds armour and MR) was completely absent and is the tell a Vayne player actually needs. Shock Blast dropping from 16s to 6s across ranks was also missing, and it is why the early punish windows disappear later in the lane.
